can_see_managed_users.description:
Whether the user can see other enterprise users in their
contact list.

external_app_user_id.description:
An external identifier for an app user, which can be used to look
up the user. This can be used to tie user IDs from external
identity providers to Box users.

is_exempt_from_device_limits.description: Whether to exempt the user from enterprise device limits.

is_exempt_from_login_verification.description: Whether the user must use two-factor authentication.

is_external_collab_restricted.description:
Whether the user is allowed to collaborate with users outside
their enterprise.

is_platform_access_only.description: Specifies that the user is an app user.

is_sync_enabled.description: Whether the user can use Box Sync.

language.description:
The language of the user, formatted in modified version of the
[ISO 639-1](https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/language-codes) format.

login.description:
The email address the user uses to log in

Required, unless `is_platform_access_only`
is set to `true`.

space_amount.description:
The user’s total available space in bytes. Set this to `-1` to
indicate unlimited storage.

tracking_codes.description:
Tracking codes allow an admin to generate reports from the
admin console and assign an attribute to a specific group
of users. This setting must be enabled for an enterprise before it
can be used.

items.description:
Tracking codes allow an admin to generate reports from the admin console
and assign an attribute to a specific group of users.
This setting must be enabled for an enterprise before it can be used.

name.description:
The name of the tracking code, which must be preconfigured in
the Admin Console.

value.description: The value of the tracking code.

items.title: Tracking code

fields.description:
A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the
response. This can be used to request fields that are
not normally returned in a standard response.

Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the
effect that none of the standard fields are returned in
the response unless explicitly specified, instead only
fields for the mini representation are returned, additional
to the fields requested.

wrapper_normalization_policy.rationale: Tool-calling parameter interfaces require closed object schemas (additionalProperties: false) across root and transport surface containers to prevent LLM argument hallucination and enforce strict argument validation. This normalization is explicitly classified as a non-lossless wrapper policy.
